responsibility: This generated header defines the tiny global linkage-configuration interface used by the GNU Modula-2 mc-boot runtime to control module initialization ordering. It exports the shared `M2LINK_ForcedModuleInitOrder` string and `M2LINK_StaticInitialization` flag that other startup and dependency-management code can inspect to choose or force static module construction behavior, serving as configuration state for runtime linking/initialization policy rather than implementing dependency resolution itself.
